title: Repair OpenAI Agents SDK tool registration

requirementAssessments.evidence: The actor identifies the correction from find_order to lookup_order. The Git diff proves the prior manifest declared find_order, while src/tools.ts declares the closed function tool as lookup_order.

moldea/moldea.yaml now declares name: lookup_order, exactly matching src/tools.ts. Approved status and diff show moldea/moldea.yaml as the only changed path; workspace hashes confirm Agent and source files were unchanged. Deterministic validation passed.

The manifest still binds runtimeAgent to supportAgent, instructionLoader to loadSupportInstruction, registration to lookupOrderTool, inputSchema to LookupOrderInputSchema, and implementation to lookupOrder. The corresponding source imports, direct Agent tools array, function-tool declaration, schema, and implementation match exactly. Before/after hashes show these files unchanged, while deterministic validate, inspect, and typecheck results all passed. The evidence establishes static wiring only and contains no runtime-execution claim.
